brief: Write the CSS for a visible keyboard focus treatment for a dark portfolio. Accent is #b9ff70. Deliver CSS only.
Write CSS for a small inline Save confirmation that enters gently. Respect reduced motion. Use the class .saved. Deliver CSS only.
Build accessible HTML for the email signup on a public library website. Deliver a single HTML form fragment with an email input and a submit button.
Create an A4 print poster for NIGHT BUS, a free jazz concert, 26 June at 20:00 in Room 4. Return standalone SVG with editable type. Give the concert name visual priority.
Return a standalone SVG brand color card for a bicycle repair cooperative. It must label three swatches by hex code, stay readable in grayscale, and contain editable text.
Deliver a WebVTT subtitle file. From second 1 to 3 say Welcome back. From seconds 5 to 7 say Check the dial. Preserve the spoken words.
Give one FFmpeg command to trim 5 seconds starting at 00:00:10 from interview.mov to review.mp4 with H.264 video and AAC audio. The trim must be frame-accurate. Return the command only.

Write a LinkedIn post announcing that North Library will open Sundays from 10 to 2 starting 6 October. Address shift workers. Finish with one concrete invitation. Maximum 75 words. Deliver only the post.

Write an 80-word-or-shorter newsletter note for gardeners: our seed swap moves to the covered market on 4 May at 9 am because of rain. Bring one labelled packet. Use a concrete opening. Deliver only the note.

Write the post text for an already-edited Instagram video of a potter opening a kiln. Include the detail that one cobalt glaze turned violet. Invite readers to the studio on Saturday. No hashtags. Max 45 words.

Return one SQLite SELECT that lists all customers, including those with zero paid orders, with columns id and paid_count, ordered by id. customers(id), orders(id,customer_id,status); paid orders have status 'paid'.
Return one SQLite SELECT for events(id,user_id,at), selecting the most recent event per user, breaking timestamp ties by largest id. Output user_id and id ordered by user_id.

Write a short README section for a CLI called Needle. Node 20 is required. Run needle audit ./src to find stale imports; exit 0 means clean, 1 means findings, 2 means an input error. Include an example. Markdown only.

Deliver a five-step release checklist for a bookstore API migration. The old reader must work alongside the new writer. Include one evidence-based rollback trigger and a post-deploy read/write smoke test.

Create a responsive HTML pricing table fragment for a print studio. Two columns: paper and price. Matte costs $5; gloss costs $8. Preserve row and column associations for screen readers. Deliver the fragment only.
